module: OBSOLETE auxiliary controller (log E at load: to be replaced by genericGauges) that feeds an HTML dashboard screen (htmlTexture) for an electric vehicle: speed, gear, sensors, navigation map, average/instantaneous consumption (W, kWh/100 km) and estimated range based on the energy of the electric motors' batteries.
notes: jbeam keys read: materialName (HTML texture material, required), htmlPath (path of the HTML page, required). Without either one, logs E and updateGFX becomes nop.
Data is sent only if a player is seated and if obj:getUpdateUIflag() is true (limited rate). JS calls: updateData, updateMap, updateConsum, appendGraphConsum (every 5 s), setUnits, updateMode.
The unit is read from the uiUnitLength setting ("metric" by default).
The electric motor must expose registeredEnergyStorages for the batteries to be counted.
reset calls htmlTexture.call even if gaugesScreenName is nil (missing material).

init.desc: Creates the HTML texture, finds the electric motors' batteries and initializes the consumption smoothers.

reset.desc: Returns the length unit to the HTML page.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: computes power and consumption and sends the data to the HTML page.

setUIMode.desc: Displays the name and color of the driving mode on the HTML screen (updateMode).

modeColor.desc: Color (inferred from code: CSS value passed as is).

setParameters.desc: Applies external parameters: if modeName and modeColor are present, calls setUIMode.
